rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to say that something happens once every hour.

example.traditional: 呢部巴士每個鐘頭有一班。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 baa1 si6 mui5 go3 zung1 tau4 jau5 jat1 baan1

rows.note: Use this especially in timetables, announcements, and other precise or formal descriptions of an hourly service.

example.english: The timetable says that a train departs hourly.
example.traditional: 時刻表寫明列車每小時開出一班。
example.jyutping: si4 hak1 biu2 se2 ming4 lit6 ce1 mui5 siu2 si4 hoi1 ceot1 jat1 baan1
